title: Route_36
lead_summary:
Route 36 is a route that connects Violet City to the National Park, Route 37 and the Ruins of Alph. There is also a small shortcut to reach Route 35 directly without going through the National Park.
There is a well, next to the gate to the National Park, which adds 36 spirits to the OddKeyStone required to obtain Spiritomb once a day.
There is a Sudowoodo that blocks the path the fork between the North, the South-West and the South-East. A lady in Goldenrod City mentions that she gave a Squirtbottle to her friend, but she is in Ecruteak City.
